name: sprint-compare
description: Three-way sprint comparison. B uses set_input(sprint), C injects ctrl+W through the HID/key event layer. A is a one-off human run (ctrl+w) whose steady speed can be passed with --a-speed.

groups.C: key_event(Control down) + key_event(W down) via HID

note: Speed is always derived from adjacent tick positions; StateVector.vel is pre-friction (~0.546x) and must not be used.
